title: Why not WhatsApp, Excel or paper?
lead: Most nurseries start there. Here is the same job, done both ways.
caption: WhatsApp, Excel and paper compared with Yawmy Care, job by job

rows.old: Written twice: once on paper, once on WhatsApp.
rows.new: Logged as it happens, then sent in one tap to every parent, in their own language.

rows.old: Parents message at midnight, and you answer in case they think something is wrong.
rows.new: Parents see what their child ate, how long she slept and the day's photos, without messaging anyone.

rows.old: Marked on paper, then copied into a spreadsheet.
rows.new: Parents check in from the gate, within 100 metres. Teachers see who is in, late or out at a glance.

rows.old: Scrolling a group where twelve families look for their own.
rows.new: Each photo goes to that child's own gallery.
